preconditions.expression: len(stdin) > 0 and all(c in '()' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string is non-empty and consists only of '(' and ')'.

postconditions.description: The output is a tuple containing the length of the longest regular bracket sequence and the number of such sequences.
The length of the longest regular bracket sequence is non-negative, and there is at least one such sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(is_regular(substring) for substring in all_substrings if len(substring) == max_length)
postconditions.description: All substrings of maximum length are regular bracket sequences.

postconditions.expression: count == sum(1 for substring in all_substrings if len(substring) == max_length and is_regular(substring))
postconditions.description: The count of longest regular bracket sequences is equal to the number of such sequences.
